scope: Three fixed official postal tables plus bounded official references; aggregate-only preflight, not a complete national assignment release

table_probes.coverage: Eastern-circle page only; do not relabel as nationwide

reference_probes.edition: 09/2014; complete one-page guide text reviewed; format and routing semantics only

transport_policy.optional: explicit local curl executable with default TLS verification, disabled curlrc, no automatic redirects, fixed HTTPS hosts and byte/time limits

assignment_policy.blank_codes: Keep blank-code office rows unassigned. Never fill from previous or next row, routing digits, parent office or geographic proximity.
assignment_policy.office_classes: District office classes are recognized only from explicit English name suffixes. Regional Bengali type cells use a reviewed finite mapping; unknown labels remain unknown.
assignment_policy.row_identity: Serial numbers and postcode strings are not stable office identifiers. Report repeated codes and office-context conflicts without deduplicating or choosing a winner.
assignment_policy.context: Missing Upazila, accounting-office or head-office cells remain missing; no forward fill. HTML spans are rejected pending separate review.
assignment_policy.digits: Normalize Bengali and ASCII digit text for syntax checks, retaining source-script counts. Four digits alone are not allocation or delivery evidence.
assignment_policy.geometry: M2_assignment does not require invented polygons. All observed office-table evidence has geometry none; M3 geometry/address and M4 building gates remain separate.
assignment_policy.temporal: Content-specific dates are distinct from the site-wide footer timestamp, HTTP Date, capture time and assignment validity. No current assignment edition is inferred from page access.

rights_review.postal: No exact permission for retained national snapshots, transformation or redistributed office assignments was established in the reviewed pages; link visibility and government authorship are not a licence.
rights_review.nsdi: The FAQ permits free access/use in general but requires provider-specific terms and SoB licensing compliance. This is not Bangladesh Post's assignment licence.
rights_review.mapping_and_census: SoB products, NSDI catalogs, BBS census information and DLRS maps are separate authorities; neither public catalog access nor map purchase supplies postal allocation, civic-address or building relations.
rights_review.completeness: Two district pages and one regional page do not satisfy the existing complete national M2_assignment criterion.
rights_review.privacy: No recipient, sender, box holder, contact, tracking, census microdata, landholder, owner, occupant, household, credential or protected data is retained.
authority_gates: Accounts, payments, contract acceptance, protected queries, new public data destinations/repositories and production deployment require explicit authorization.
rights_review.no_blanket_unavailability_claim: A TLS failure on the legacy portal is not evidence that all Bangladesh Post data is unavailable; the main and regional hosts were reachable with Windows Schannel verification.
